```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(leaflet)
```

This interactive map highlights a small collection of remarkable places across
India. Select a marker to learn more, use the layer control to switch the
basemap, and zoom in to explore.

```{r map}
places <- data.frame(
  name = c("Taj Mahal", "Gateway of India", "Hawa Mahal", "Mysore Palace",
           "Victoria Memorial", "Meenakshi Temple", "Golden Temple"),
  city = c("Agra", "Mumbai", "Jaipur", "Mysuru", "Kolkata", "Madurai", "Amritsar"),
  lat = c(27.1751, 18.9220, 26.9239, 12.3052, 22.5448, 9.9195, 31.6200),
  lng = c(78.0421, 72.8347, 75.8267, 76.6552, 88.3426, 78.1193, 74.8765),
  type = c("Monument", "Monument", "Palace", "Palace", "Museum", "Temple", "Temple"),
  fact = c(
    "A white-marble mausoleum and UNESCO World Heritage Site.",
    "An Indo-Saracenic arch overlooking Mumbai Harbour.",
    "Jaipur's celebrated Palace of Winds, completed in 1799.",
    "The illuminated royal residence of the Wadiyar dynasty.",
    "A marble museum dedicated to Queen Victoria.",
    "A historic temple complex known for its colourful gopurams.",
    "The spiritual centre of Sikhism, surrounded by the Amrit Sarovar."
  )
)

pal <- colorFactor(
  palette = c("#e85d75", "#f4a261", "#2a9d8f", "#457b9d"),
  domain = places$type
)

leaflet(places) |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron, group = "Light") |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$OpenStreetMap.Mapnik, group = "Street") |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~lng, lat = ~lat,
    radius = 8, color = "white", weight = 2,
    fillColor = ~pal(type), fillOpacity = 0.9,
    label = ~name,
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<div style='min-width:210px'>",
      "<h3 style='margin:0 0 5px;color:#12355b'>", name, "</h3>",
      "<b>", city, "</b> · ", type,
      "<p style='margin-bottom:0'>", fact, "</p></div>"
    )
  ) |>
  addLegend("bottomright", pal = pal, values = ~type,
            title = "Place type", opacity = 0.9) |>
  addLayersControl(
    baseGroups = c("Light", "Street"),
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  ) |>
  fitBounds(lng1 = 68, lat1 = 7, lng2 = 97, lat2 = 36)
```
